identitySignals: Name matches exactly: the Los Angeles County location directory lists 'California State University, The - Office Of The Chancellor' at 401 Golden Shore, Long Beach, CA 90802, with a calstate.edu web address

The agenda item is a data sharing and direct admissions partnership with the CSU Chancellor's Office, which runs systemwide programs for the California State University system, a public university system that includes campuses serving the Oakland area

Wikipedia's California State University entry gives the official website as calstate.edu and describes a state public university system headed by a chancellor, consistent with the agency in the agenda
research.notes: calstate.edu blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so the CSU's own pages could not be cited. Phone is the Chancellor's Office administrative line as listed by the LA County directory; a web search also showed (562) 951-4000 as the main line. Public agency of the State of California, so no EIN/UEI looked up.

profile.summary: The Office of the Chancellor is the systemwide headquarters of the California State University, a public university system of the State of California. The Chancellor is the chief executive officer of the system and an ex-officio member of its Board of Trustees.
